_readme: CANONICAL Moodily pricing (v1-2026). build.py reads this file and FAILS if a price here disagrees with src/data/services.json, if a payment URL is not a rzp.io Razorpay Payment Link, or if a quote/onboarding product gets a checkout URL. Payment URLs are public Razorpay Payment Links approved by the owner — they carry no secrets. A Razorpay Plan ID is NOT a checkout URL and is never rendered as a button.

foundingStarter.name: Founding 10 — Google + WhatsApp Starter
foundingStarter._scope_readme: Founding scope = exactly the WhatsApp Business Basic scope + the Google Business Quick Fix scope. That is what makes the displayed saving (individual total − founding price) mathematically true. Change 'bundle_of' only together with the public scope copy.

digitalStarter._links_readme: Two separate FIXED-amount links, both with partial payment disabled (verified 2026-09-19): ₹2,500 advance (HSbE7we) and ₹4,999 full (fm6B5Jn). The balance ₹2,499 is collected by a separate link before final handover — never auto-charged.

localBusinessGrowth.payment_terms: 50% project advance after written scope approval · 50% before final handover

digitalSaathi._plan_readme: Subscription infrastructure only. A Plan ID is not a customer checkout. Subscriptions are created per customer after onboarding — never from a public button.

founding._readme: FOUNDING_OFFER_ACTIVE / FOUNDING_SLOT_LIMIT / FOUNDING_SLOTS_CONFIRMED / FOUNDING_SLOTS_USED. This static site has no live inventory: the public page never shows a remaining count unless slots_confirmed is true (owner has reconciled Razorpay + offline founding clients). Track customers as F01…F10 in MOODILY-OS (private, outside this public repo). When F10 is served, set active=false.
